title: cyperus rotundus var. nubicus
intro: Cyperus rotundus var. nubicus, commonly known as the desert papyrus, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. The desert papyrus is valued for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the desert papyrus include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
